commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Francisco Maeso interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Raul Albiol (Villarreal).
90+3' Kenedy (Valladolid) misses a complete sitter from the corner, heading the ball well wide of the left post from close in.
90+2' Kike Perez (Valladolid) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Juan Bernat (Villarreal) on for Alex Baena.
90' Marcelino prepares a substitution. Nicolas Pepe is replaced by Ramon Terrats (Villarreal).
88' Substitution. Anuar leaves the pitch and is replaced by Kenedy (Valladolid).
88' Camilo Speranza decides to make a substitution. Eray Comert will be replaced by Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid).
84' 1 - 2 Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) finds some space inside the box and scores with a terrific header inside the left post, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
84' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Villarreal.

84' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) blows a promising chance. He gets to a rebound and unleashes a shot towards the top of the net. However, his effort is thwarted by a perfect save from Karl Hein, who deflects it onto the bar with the tips of his fingers. The referee blows his whistle, Villarreal are awarded a corner kick.
82' Marcelino has decided to make a change. Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) replaces Ilias Akhomach.

82' A neat pass is well received by Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
79' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Selim Amallah as he is replaced by Kike Perez (Valladolid).
79' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the right post!
77' Villarreal work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
76' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) takes a nice touch on the edge of the box as he meets a pass and produces a shot towards the roof of the net. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper!
73' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Karl Hein is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
71' A substitution has been made. Mario Martin goes off and Victor Andres Meseguer Cavas (Valladolid) comes on.
71' The substitution is prepared. Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Mamadou Sylla.
71' Marcelino has decided to substitute Santi Comesana and he is replaced by Pape Gueye (Villarreal).
70' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Thierno Barry walks off the pitch to be replaced by Ayoze Perez (Villarreal).
69' Francisco Maeso shows a yellow card to David Torres (Valladolid) for his blatant foul.
68' Selim Amallah (Valladolid) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post.
67' Valladolid take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

66' Anuar (Valladolid) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball goes out for a corner. Valladolid can continue in their attacking effort.

64' Logan Costa (Villarreal) won himself just enough space to connect with the corner inside the box. His header flew towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper dived superbly to stop the effort.
64' Alex Baena (Villarreal) is about to take a corner kick.

62' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well wide of the right post.
61' Eray Comert (Valladolid) has tested the patience of referee Francisco Maeso and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
60' 1 - 1 Goal! Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Diego Conde into the bottom left corner.
60' Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
59' Logan Costa (Villarreal) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francisco Maeso had an easy-decision to make.
59' Francisco Maeso blows the whistle, Logan Costa (Villarreal) is penalised for a foul. It's a penalty! Great chance to score for Valladolid!
59' The attendance for today's match is 20170.
56' Francisco Maeso shows a yellow card to Javier Sanchez (Valladolid) for his blatant foul.
55' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
54' The resulting corner from Alex Baena (Villarreal) is cleared by the defence.
54' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Villarreal will take a corner kick.
53' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just over the crossbar.
51' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Lucas Rosa (Valladolid).
50' Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) attempts to discuss the decision with Francisco Maeso, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
49' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
49' Alex Baena (Villarreal) received a precise low pass and attempted to surprise the keeper with a snap shot, but his beautiful shot smashed against the right post!
48' Francisco Maeso has a clear sight and sees a foul from Selim Amallah (Valladolid).
47' Alex Baena (Villarreal) sends a cross into the box, but Karl Hein comes off his line to gather the ball.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Francisco Maeso has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Dani Parejo (Villarreal) was quite harsh and Francisco Maeso didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. If it wasn't for Karl Hein's superb save the ball would have probably ended up in the bottom right corner.
43' Lucas Rosa (Valladolid) makes a strong challenge and Francisco Maeso blows for a foul.
41' Alex Baena (Villarreal) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Karl Hein comes off his line to intercept.
38' A player from Villarreal commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
38' The referee awards a corner and Alex Baena (Villarreal) goes over to take it.
36' Selim Amallah (Valladolid) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

35' Luis Perez (Valladolid) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball goes behind for a corner. Valladolid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

32' Nice individual effort by Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a shot to the left side of the goal, but Karl Hein does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out.
31' An attempted cross from Raul Moro (Valladolid) is cleared.
29' 0 - 1 Goal! Thierno Barry (Villarreal) makes the score 0:1 after burying a close-range header in the left side of the goal after a good run and cross by Kiko Femenia.
27' Raul Moro (Valladolid) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
26' Kiko Femenia (Villarreal) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
23' Mario Martin (Valladolid) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom left corner, but Diego Conde is equal to it and makes an easy save.
18' Anuar (Valladolid) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the roof of the net. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Diego Conde makes a comfortable save.
17' Alex Baena (Villarreal) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
16' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Corner kick. Villarreal will have an opportunity.
14' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) commits a rough foul. Francisco Maeso stops the game and makes a call.
12' A precise low pass is received by Thierno Barry (Villarreal), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
9' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and flies well wide of the left post.
5' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle. Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) commits a foul after dangerous play.
3' Raul Albiol (Villarreal) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
3' Raul Moro (Valladolid) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
3' Selim Amallah (Valladolid) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
3' Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Valladolid have been awarded a corner kick.
1' It looks like Santi Comesana (Villarreal) saw red with that tackle. Francisco Maeso won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Valladolid will kick the game off.
Francisco Maeso is introduced as the referee for today's match.
